authority.source_authority: DAD owns its candidate capability, skill, role-pack, workflow, and navigation contracts. Each project repository retains project truth and Lowell retains intended destination, completion depth, integration, priority, budget, activation, and acceptance authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-registry-writer may edit the isolated worktree. Lifecycle and expert-suite specialists are read-only; the independent checker may inspect and test but cannot modify candidate artifacts.

roles.why_needed: Project evidence, intended destination, completion depth, and sufficient stopping conditions require a distinct lifecycle and right-sizing design lane.
roles.mission: Design a read-only project-position diagnosis, basic-issue triage, user clarification, target-state contract, and smallest sufficient continuation route without creating a parallel project state machine.
roles.authority: Read-only design. May recommend questions, diagnostic dimensions, and routes but cannot infer the user's destination, change project state, or start work.
acceptance_conditions: The design distinguishes project position from desired end state and completion depth.
A minor repair or integration request does not activate a full product lifecycle.
User questions are bounded to three immediate decisions.
stop_conditions: The design creates a competing lifecycle vocabulary.
The destination would be inferred from repository activity alone.

readiness_conditions: Existing PM and product-catalyst contracts are reconciled.

roles.why_needed: The existing MCP and Product/UX core families need a gap audit before adding specialist expertise.
roles.mission: Inventory current MCP and UI/UX roles, identify genuinely distinct expert methods and authority boundaries, and propose routed specialist packs that are instantiated only when applicable.
roles.authority: Read-only inventory and design. Cannot install MCP, configure hosts, activate connectors, change interfaces, or create external effects.
acceptance_conditions: Existing families are extended rather than duplicated.
Each proposed expert has distinct inputs, outputs, failure modes, and activation triggers.
The smallest subset is routed instead of activating the full suite.
stop_conditions: A proposed role is only a title without distinct method or validation.
Current MCP details would require unverified volatile assumptions.

readiness_conditions: Every new role is deduplicated against the current library.

roles.why_needed: One writer must integrate the accepted diagnostic and specialist-pack contracts into DAD without overlapping edits.
roles.mission: Implement the project-position diagnostician, right-sized workflow, MCP expert pack, UI/UX expert pack, registry/graph links, documentation, navigation, and deterministic tests.
roles.authority: May edit only task-scoped DAD skill, registry, documentation, navigation, roadmap-evidence, and test artifacts in the isolated worktree. Cannot activate agents, automation, connectors, or external systems.
acceptance_conditions: Project position, purpose, desired end state, integration target, completion depth, and sufficient stop are explicit.
Existing Integration/MCP and Product/UX families point to validated specialist packs.
Routing and schemas pass deterministic tests and repository validation.
stop_conditions: A schema or authority change expands beyond candidate routing metadata.
Implementation requires external configuration, credentials, or project-repository writes.

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass and all changed paths are enumerated.

roles.why_needed: A right-sizing system must be independently checked for accidental overbuild, role duplication, and authority drift.
roles.mission: Verify the frozen change from source evidence, challenge full-lifecycle defaulting, check MCP-first and UI/UX coverage, replay schemas/tests, and report blockers or residual risks.
roles.authority: Read-only independent review. Cannot edit, approve activation, or infer Lowell's project destination.
acceptance_conditions: Minor tasks route without full-family execution.
User intent gates destination and completion depth.
MCP and UI/UX roles are discoverable, distinct, and bounded.
stop_conditions: Source evidence or test replay is unavailable.

readiness_conditions: Frozen artifacts and exact commands are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove diagnosis and routing stop at the smallest sufficient outcome rather than defaulting to an end-to-end product build.
Prove the existing Integration/MCP family gains distinct MCP specialists without a competing family or external authority.
Prove the Product/UX family can route a broad expertise suite while activating only the smallest applicable subset.
Prove repository activity and model inference cannot establish the desired destination, integration target, or completion depth.
